data.description: Phase B foundation. The scrape rail has 0 live call sites — nothing invokes scrapers at restore. Build the seam: at surface restore, per-kind scraper -> [ScrapeCandidate] -> strategy.capture -> store.applyScrape, so captured refs drive strategy.resume next restore. Injectable filesystem for tests. Benefits codex too. Acceptance: test proves a scraped candidate becomes a resumable ref; claude/codex unaffected; c11-logic green. BLOCKS the pi and omp tickets.

data.body: MV audit (commit 00e5801c9, validation phase): c11-logic green locally — ScrapeCapturePipelineTests = 7 tests, 0 failures. Validation row 4 (scrape→capture→resume pipeline) confirmed. MV audit (validation phase): validation artifact reviewed — its 'live-agent resume deferred to pi/omp' is CORRECT and plan-consistent, NOT a gap. Per validation-plan, C11-152's acceptance is row 4 (scrape→capture→resume integration test) + row 5 (no claude/codex regression) — both test-based; the load-bearing LIVE rows are 1 (opencode), 6 (pi), 7 (omp). ✅ C11-152 COMPLETE — at pr_open, ready for auto-merge (squash). Delegator stopping per boot.

**PR:** https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/273  (feat/c11-152-scrape-capture → main, branched off main @ 3428ceb20)

**What landed — the missing restore seam.** The scrape rail had 0 live call sites; this wires it in:
per-kind scraper → `ScrapeCapturePipeline` (`strategy.capture`) → `ConversationStore.applyScrape`,
called live from `AppDelegate.prepareStartupSessionSnapshotIfNeeded` after seed, before no-resume/dirty.

**Public seam for C11-153/154 (AUTHORITATIVE — additive, stable):**
- `ConversationScraper` protocol (`var kind`, `func candidates(cwd:) -> [ScrapeCandidate]`); Claude/Codex conform.
- `ConversationScraperRegistry` + `static func v1(filesystem:)` — pi/omp append ONE scraper here.
- `ScrapeCaptureContext` (+ `contexts(from: AppSessionSnapshot)`), `ScrapeCapturePipeline(scrapers:strategies:)` with `captureRefs(contexts:existing:)`.
- `ConversationStore.applyScrape(surfaceId:ref:)` and `runScrapeCapture(contexts:pipeline:)`.
pi/omp build: `PiScraper`/`OmpScraper: ConversationScraper` + register in scraper `v1`; `PiStrategy`/`OmpStrategy` + register in `ConversationStrategyRegistry.v1`. The pipeline + call site pick them up automatically once registered.

**Gates:** plan-review FAIL→resolved (recordScrape caller + cross-target MockFS findings folded in);
own-reviewer code-review PASS (lattice CLI hit an empty-diff because it resolves git from the main
checkout, not the worktree — fallback per boot HARD RULE). Validation: 7 acceptance/round-trip tests +
14 regression green on `c11-logic`; `xcodebuild -scheme c11 build` SUCCEEDED. Full observed live-agent
exact-session resume deferred to C11-153/154 (they own per-agent live snapshot/restore) — rationale in
the validation artifact.
